sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等众多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无保留、原汁原味的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选访谈，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》App 进行观看，并免费畅读我们所有的独家报道一个月。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不会想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily News today.
sentences.zh: 这里是今日《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Millions of Americans watched on Tuesday night as President Trump made his case for a wall on the southern border and as Democratic leaders rebuked that case.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，数百万美国人观看了特朗普总统就南部边境墙阐述其立场，以及民主党领袖对该立场的驳斥。

sentences.en: Why did we need a presidential address for both sides to say what they've been saying for weeks?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们需要发表总统演讲，让双方重复他们已经讲了好几周的话？

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, January 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月9日，星期三。

sentences.en: Are you going to do the music?
sentences.zh: 你要放音乐吗？

sentences.en: Oh, that was pretty good.
sentences.zh: 哦，那个挺好听的。

sentences.en: Oh, it's like burned in your brain, right?
sentences.zh: 哦，就像烙印在你的脑子里一样，对吧？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I can do all three.
sentences.zh: 这三个我都会。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Michael Graham, you cover media for The Times.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·格雷厄姆，你负责《时报》的媒体报道。

sentences.en: What's the significance of a presidential address to the nation?
sentences.zh: 总统向全国发表讲话有什么重要意义？

sentences.en: There's a whole ritual surrounding these events.
sentences.zh: 这些重大活动周围有一整套仪式感。

sentences.en: This is an ABC News special report.
sentences.zh: 这是一场美国广播公司新闻特别报道。

sentences.en: The president breaks into regular programming.
sentences.zh: 总统打断了常规节目。

sentences.en: There's a special bulletin.
sentences.zh: 有一条特别快讯。

sentences.en: This is an NBC News special report.
sentences.zh: 这是一场全国广播公司新闻特别报道。

sentences.en: You hear that trumpet score come out from NBC News.
sentences.zh: 你听到了全国广播公司新闻标志性的号角声。

sentences.en: A presidential address to the nation.
sentences.zh: 总统向全国发表讲话。

sentences.en: It all signals to us that something very important is going on.
sentences.zh: 这一切都在向我们发出信号，表明有非常重要的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Tonight, I can report to the American people and to the world.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我可以向美国人民和全世界报告。

sentences.en: You have the president typically in the Oval Office, not always, but looking directly into the camera.
sentences.zh: 总统通常在椭圆形办公室里，虽然不总是这样，但会直视镜头。

sentences.en: The United States has conducted an operation that killed Osama bin Laden, the leader of al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 美国已经实施了一次行动，击毙了基地组织领导人本·拉登。

sentences.en: Addressing his public, there's a certain statesman quality to it that I think underscores that these are moments that we all kind of remember.
sentences.zh: 向公众发表讲话时，有一种独特的国是风范，我认为这突显了这些都是我们都会铭记的时刻。

sentences.en: And what are the occasions on which these speeches are generally delivered?
sentences.zh: 这些演讲通常是在什么场合发表的？

sentences.en: From the president's office in the White House in Washington, D.C., we present a special address by the president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 我们在华盛顿特区白宫总统办公室为您播报美国总统的特别讲话，

sentences.en: Dwight D.
sentences.zh: 德怀特·D·

sentences.en: Eisenhower.
sentences.zh: 艾森豪威尔。

sentences.en: Dwight Eisenhower in one of the very first times this presidential address ever happened because TV was a new thing.
sentences.zh: 德怀特·艾森豪威尔这是有史以来最早几次总统全国讲话之一，因为当时电视还是个新事物。

sentences.en: Good evening, my fellow citizens.
sentences.zh: 晚安，同胞们。

sentences.en: For a few minutes this evening, I should like to speak to you about the serious situation that has arisen in Little Rock.
sentences.zh: 今晚我想用几分钟时间，和大家谈谈小石城出现严峻局势的问题。

sentences.en: Told the country why he was desegregating the schools in Little Rock, Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 向全国讲述了他为什么要对阿肯色州小石城的学校进行废除种族隔离。

sentences.en: Just two hours ago, Allied air forces began an attack on military targets in Iraq and Kuwait.
sentences.zh: 就在两小时前，盟军空军开始对伊拉克和科威特的军事目标发动攻击。

sentences.en: And I think the ones that immediately come to mind are when the president has decided to take our nation to war.
sentences.zh: 我想人们脑海中最先浮现的，往往是总统决定带领国家走向战争的时候。

sentences.en: Tonight, as our forces fight, they and their families are in our prayers.
sentences.zh: 今晚，当我们的军队在战斗时，他们和他们的家人都在我们的祈祷之中。

sentences.en: My fellow citizens, at this hour, American and coalition forces are in the early stages of military operations
sentences.zh: 同胞们，此时此刻，美军及盟军正处于军事行动的初期阶段

sentences.en: to disarm Iraq, to free its people, and to defend the world from grave danger.
sentences.zh: 旨在解除伊拉克的武装，解放其人民，并保护世界免受严重威胁。

sentences.en: Or even when a national tragedy occurs.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至是发生国家悲剧的时候。

sentences.en: Nancy and I are pained to the core by the tragedy of the shuttle Challenger.
sentences.zh: 我和南希对挑战者号航天飞机悲剧感到痛心疾首。

sentences.en: In the aftermath of the attempt, we continue to hold the government of Iran responsible
sentences.zh: 在袭击发生后，我们继续要求伊朗政府对人质的安全以及

sentences.en: for the safety and for the early release of the American hostages who have been held so long.
sentences.zh: 长期被扣押的美国人质的尽早获释承担责任。

sentences.en: Today, our fellow citizens, our way of life, our very freedom came under attack in a series of deliberate and deadly terrorist acts.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们的同胞、我们的生活方式、我们的自由本身在一系列蓄意且致命的恐怖袭击中遭到攻击。

sentences.en: It tends to be kind of a sober or solemn occasion.
sentences.zh: 这往往是一个比较清醒或庄严的时刻。

sentences.en: May God bless our country and all who defend her.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我们的国家以及所有捍卫她的人。

sentences.en: And this is President Trump's first time delivering this kind of speech.
sentences.zh: 这也是特朗普总统第一次发表这种演讲。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so what happened when the president went to the networks and asked for this time?
sentences.zh: 那么，当总统找到各大电视网并申请这段时间时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: Normally, when the White House goes to these networks, requests the time, it's really a pro forma thing.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，当白宫找到这些电视网并请求转播时间时，这其实只是个形式上的流程。

sentences.en: It's a very rare thing to ask for, and the networks defer.
sentences.zh: 提出这种要求非常罕见，而各大电视网通常都会顺从。

sentences.en: The president wants to address the American people.
sentences.zh: 总统希望向美国人民发表讲话。

sentences.en: So they almost automatically say yes.
sentences.zh: 所以他们几乎会不假思索地答应。

sentences.en: It's pretty much automatic.
sentences.zh: 几乎是自动同意的。

sentences.en: But in this case, there was a lot of deliberation.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，经过了大量的审议。

sentences.en: This is an unfiltered platform for the president to reach tens of millions of Americans.
sentences.zh: 这是总统向数千万美国人发声的一个无过滤平台。

sentences.en: And President Trump, when he talks about the wall, when he talks about border security, it's been well documented that he makes false claims that he can mislead the public.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普总统在谈论边境墙、边境安全时，有据可查的是他会发表虚假言论，误导公众。

sentences.en: For the networks to hand over their airtime felt like a question of their responsibility to viewers.
sentences.zh: 对于各大电视网来说，交出黄金时段的播出时间似乎关乎他们对观众的责任。

sentences.en: Can they fact check him sufficiently?
sentences.zh: 他们能对其实施充分的事实核查吗？

sentences.en: Is there a way to contextualize the statements he's making?
sentences.zh: 有没有办法对他所说的言论进行情境化解读？

sentences.en: What does it mean for a television network to let a president assert falsehoods without a filter?
sentences.zh: 电视网毫无过滤地让总统散布虚假言论意味着什么？

sentences.en: But clearly, they ended up deciding to give him their airwaves.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，他们最终还是决定将转播权交给他。

sentences.en: So there's two factors at play.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有两个因素在起作用。

sentences.en: First of all, I think they made an editorial decision that we are in the middle of a federal government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为他们做出了一个编辑层面的决定，即我们正处于联邦政府关门的关键时期。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of thousands of workers who potentially are not going to be paid this week.
sentences.zh: 有数十万工人这周可能拿不到工资。

sentences.en: That is an urgent national moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个迫在眉睫的国家紧急时刻。

sentences.en: And it feels inherently newsworthy to hear what the president has to say about it.
sentences.zh: 倾听总统对此事的看法具有天生的新闻价值。

sentences.en: The other reason is, is it paternalistic for a news network to make the decision that the American public can't hear from their president?
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是，新闻电视网替美国公众做出不能听取总统讲话的决定，这是否带有家长的作风？

sentences.en: I think a lot of executives felt that in the end that was going too far.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多高管觉得，最终那样做有点太过分了。

sentences.en: That if the president asks for this time, they ought to defer to him.
sentences.zh: 如果总统要求这段时间，他们就应该予以顺从。

sentences.en: I talked to Ted Koppel, legendary anchorman.
sentences.zh: 我采访了传奇新闻主播泰德·科佩尔。

sentences.en: He said when the president of the United States asks to address his public, you've got to have a pretty damn good reason to say no.
sentences.zh: 他说，当美国总统要求向公众发表讲话时，你必须有一个相当充分的理由才能说不。

sentences.en: I'm struck, Michael, by the fact that, yes, the government is shut down.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，令我感触深的是，一方面政府确实关门了。

sentences.en: And yes, there is a situation at the border.
sentences.zh: 另一方面边境确实有情况。

sentences.en: But as we have reported at the Times, the president has created those situations or really amplified them.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们在《时报》报道过的那样，正是总统制造了这些状况，或者说夸大了它们。

sentences.en: On the other hand, I suppose that's true of any time a president makes a declaration of war, for example, or launches a missile attack.
sentences.zh: 从另一方面来看，我想任何时候总统宣布宣战或发动导弹袭击时也是如此。

sentences.en: They have made a decision that creates the urgent moment that then merits this primetime speech.
sentences.zh: 他们做出的决定制造了紧急时刻，从而使得这场黄金时段的演讲变得合理。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I think TV networks, you see this over and over again.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你会一次又一次地在电视网上看到这种情况。

sentences.en: They've made the decision.
sentences.zh: 他们已经做出了决定。

sentences.en: They're not going to parse the motives or the political posturing at play with the president.
sentences.zh: 他们不打算去剖析总统此举背后的动机或政治姿态。

sentences.en: They're going to assess, is the nation in a moment of crisis?
sentences.zh: 他们将评估的是：国家是否正处于危机时刻？

sentences.en: And they've determined that in this case.
sentences.zh: 他们在这次事件中做出了肯定的判断。

sentences.en: Understanding that, how are the networks approaching this in a way that they feel is commensurate to the moment
sentences.zh: 基于这种理解，各大电视网将如何以一种他们认为与当前形势相匹配的方式来处理这件事

sentences.en: and responsible given their concerns about this president's history of exaggerations, misinformation?
sentences.zh: 并且鉴于他们对这位总统夸大其词、散布虚假信息的历史的担忧，怎样做才算负责任？

sentences.en: So as soon as they agreed to air it, the Democratic leadership said, hey, wait a second, we need a chance to talk to the same audience.
sentences.zh: 因此，就在他们同意播出后，民主党领导层表示，嘿，等一下，我们也需要有机会向同一受众发声。

sentences.en: So the networks have created an interesting format.
sentences.zh: 于是电视网设计了一个有趣的节目形式。

sentences.en: The president will come out and talk for what's expected to be eight minutes.
sentences.zh: 预计总统将登台发言八分钟。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer and Nancy Pelosi will then have a few minutes to come on and respond to what Trump just said.
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默和南希·佩洛西随后将有几分钟的时间登台回应特朗普刚才的讲话。

sentences.en: And after that, the usual anchors and White House correspondents will come on the air.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，平时的各路主播和白宫记者将登台亮相。

sentences.en: They can fact check what the president said.
sentences.zh: 他们可以核实总统所说的话是否属实。

sentences.en: They can contextualize it.
sentences.zh: 他们可以提供背景解读。

sentences.en: They can offer the assessment of why he's picked this moment to address the nation.
sentences.zh: 他们可以评估为什么他会选择在这个时刻向全国发表讲话。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, Michael, it's 8.35 p.m.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，现在是晚上8点35分。

sentences.en: How many people will be watching when the president goes out before the cameras in about 25 minutes?
sentences.zh: 在大约25分钟后总统走到镜头前时，会有多少人观看？

sentences.en: This is the biggest audience that a president can have.
sentences.zh: 这是总统能拥有的最大受众群体。

sentences.en: I would expect upwards of 20 million Americans.
sentences.zh: 我预计会有2000多万美国人观看。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 免费畅读？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App 时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，亲身体验《时报》订户每天都能获取的内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅用户，请立即下载《时报》App，即可获得30天免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: Black-ish will be seen in its entirety following this special coverage from ABC News.
sentences.zh: ABC 新闻特别报道结束后将完整播出《喜新不厌旧》。

sentences.en: This is an ABC News special report.
sentences.zh: 这是一场美国广播公司新闻特别报道。

sentences.en: This is an NBC News special report.
sentences.zh: 这是一场全国广播公司新闻特别报道。

sentences.en: This is CBS News special report.
sentences.zh: 这是一场哥伦比亚广播公司新闻特别报道。

sentences.en: I'm Jeff Glor.
sentences.zh: 我是杰夫·格洛尔。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: We're coming on the air right now because President Trump is set to address the nation.
sentences.zh: 我们现在插播节目，因为特朗普总统即将向全国发表讲话。

sentences.en: President Trump is about to deliver his first address from the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统即将发表他自上任以来的首次椭圆形办公室讲话。

sentences.en: His first primetime speech from the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 他自上任以来的首次椭圆形办公室黄金时段演讲。

sentences.en: Here now, here's the president.
sentences.zh: 现在，总统来了。

sentences.en: My fellow Americans.
sentences.zh: 全国同胞们。

sentences.en: At nine o'clock on the dot, the president appeared sitting behind the Resolute desk in the Oval Office, and he gave what began as a characteristically sober Oval Office address.
sentences.zh: 整整九点整，总统出现在椭圆形办公室的坚固办公桌后，发表了一场从开场来看颇为稳重的椭圆形办公室演讲。

sentences.en: Mark Landler covers the White House for the Times.
sentences.zh: 马克·兰勒负责《时报》的白宫报道。

sentences.en: Tonight, I am speaking to you because there is a growing humanitarian and security crisis at our southern border.
sentences.zh: 今晚我向大家发表讲话，是因为我们的南部边境正面临日益严重的人道主义和安全危机。

sentences.en: He talked about the crisis of thousands of illegal immigrants crossing the southern border every day.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了每天有成千上万非法移民越过南部边境的危机。

sentences.en: We are out of space to hold them, and we have no way to promptly return them back home to their country.
sentences.zh: 我们已经没有空间容纳他们，也没有办法迅速将他们遣返回国。

sentences.en: He then began ticking off the tangible cost of this crisis.
sentences.zh: 随后他开始逐一列举这场危机带来的切实代价。

sentences.en: Our southern border is a pipeline for vast quantities of illegal drugs, including meth, heroin, cocaine, and fentanyl.
sentences.zh: 我们的南部边境是大量非法毒品的输送管道，包括冰毒、海洛因、可卡因和芬太尼。

sentences.en: Every week, 300 of our citizens are killed by heroin alone, 90 percent of which floods across from our southern border.
sentences.zh: 每周有300名我们的同胞仅死于海洛因，其中90%是从我们的南部边境涌入的。

sentences.en: He talked about the incidences of people involved in sex crimes or violent killings that cross the border.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了越境人员涉及性犯罪或暴力谋杀的事件。

sentences.en: This is a humanitarian crisis, a crisis of the heart, and a crisis of the soul.
sentences.zh: 这是一场人道主义危机，是一场良知危机，也是一场灵魂危机。

sentences.en: And then he went on to say,
sentences.zh: 接着他继续说道，

sentences.en: This is the cycle of human suffering that I am determined to end.
sentences.zh: 这是我决心终结的人类苦难的恶性循环。

sentences.en: And from there, he then went into the proposals that he said his administration had sent to Congress to try to improve border security.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，他接着提出了他所说的其政府已提交给国会以试图改善边境安全的提案。

sentences.en: The proposal from Homeland Security includes cutting-edge technology for detecting drugs, weapons, illegal contraband, and many other things.
sentences.zh: 国土安全部的提案包括用于检测毒品、武器、非法违禁品等许多东西的尖端技术。

sentences.en: And he actually, in this part of the speech, said relatively little about a border wall.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在演讲的这部分中，他相对较少地提及了边境墙。

sentences.en: We have requested more agents, immigration judges, and bed space to process the sharp rise and unlawful migration fueled by our very strong economy.
sentences.zh: 我们已经申请了更多的特工、移民法官和床位，以处理由我们非常强劲的经济所助长的非法移民的急剧激增。

sentences.en: And then finally, after this very long windup,
sentences.zh: 最后，在经过了这段非常长的铺垫之后，

sentences.en: Finally, as part of an overall approach to border security, He got to the core of his ask, which is $5.7 billion for a physical barrier.
sentences.zh: 最终，作为总体边境安全方案的一部分，他切入了核心诉求，即为实体屏障拨款57亿美元。

sentences.en: It will be a steel barrier rather than a concrete wall.
sentences.zh: 这将是一道钢制屏障，而不是混凝土墙。

sentences.en: And so you really saw him de-emphasizing what has been the most inflamed part of the debate over immigration, his demand to build a border wall.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到，他确实在淡化移民辩论中最激烈的部分，也就是他建造边境墙的要求。

sentences.en: He's almost suggesting, look, I'm willing to call this whatever you want, and I'm even willing to conceive of it differently than I once did on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 他几乎是在暗示：听着，我不在乎你管这叫什么，我甚至愿意用不同于以往竞选时的方式来构想它。

sentences.en: So why are you Democrats being so unreasonable?
sentences.zh: 所以你们民主党人为什么这么不讲道理？

sentences.en: But I assumed that this presidential address was ultimately designed to end the government shutdown, and the government shutdown is only being held up by a wall.
sentences.zh: 但我想象中，这次总统演讲的最终目的应该是结束政府关门，而政府关门之所以僵持不下，完全是因为一堵墙。

sentences.en: So why not use this speech to persuade Americans that we need the wall?
sentences.zh: 那为什么不用这场演讲来劝说美国人，让我们确实需要这堵墙呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think he's trying to use the speech to persuade Americans we need enhanced border security across a wide variety of fronts, including a wall.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他试图通过演讲说服美国人，我们在全方位都需要加强边境安全，包括修建一堵墙。

sentences.en: I think he just doesn't want the wall to become the one sticking point, even though we all know in the debate it is, in fact, the one sticking point.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他只是不想让这堵墙成为唯一的争议焦点，尽管我们都知道，在辩论中它其实就是唯一的争议焦点。

sentences.en: This is the reason the Democrats aren't willing to make a deal with him.
sentences.zh: 这就是民主党人不愿意与他达成交易的原因。

sentences.en: They're willing to give him more money for border security.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意给他更多的资金用于边境安全。

sentences.en: That's never been an issue.
sentences.zh: 这从来都不是问题。

sentences.en: They're even willing to discuss forms of barriers.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至愿意讨论各种形式的屏障。

sentences.en: What they're not willing to do is give him nearly $6 billion to build this monstrous concrete wall.
sentences.zh: 他们不愿意做的是给他近60亿美元来建造这座巨大的混凝土墙。

sentences.en: And I think the president, in a sense, was trying to get away from that being the dominant theme of his remarks tonight.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统在某种程度上，是想摆脱这一点成为今晚他发言的主导主题。

sentences.en: But how does the speech to the American people break us through this stalemate if he doesn't convince the American people that it's specifically the wall that we need?
sentences.zh: 但如果他不让美国人相信我们特别需要这堵墙，这场面向美国人民的演讲又该如何帮我们打破这个僵局呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think that's a good question because I don't think that this speech did break through in the way that the White House hoped it would.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这是个好问题，因为我不认为这场演讲真的像白宫所希望的那样打破了僵局。

sentences.en: The president tonight needed to advance the ball.
sentences.zh: 总统今晚需要有所进展。

sentences.en: He needed to give Americans a new reason for believing in the necessity of his message on border security.
sentences.zh: 他需要给美国人一个新的理由，让他们相信他在边境安全问题上的信息是必要的。

sentences.en: And to do that, I think he needed to lay out a new set of facts or a new argument behind the facts.
sentences.zh: 为此，我认为他需要摆出一套新的事实，或者在事实背后提出新的论点。

sentences.en: And I don't believe he really did that.
sentences.zh: 而我不认为他真正做到了这一点。

sentences.en: In fact, if you look at the second half of the speech, after that very sober and measured opening, he really then shifts into very familiar and quite inflammatory rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你看看演讲的后半部分，在那个非常冷静克制的开场之后，他真的转变成了一种非常熟悉且极具煽动性的言辞。

sentences.en: Day after day, precious lives are cut short by those who have violated our borders.
sentences.zh: 日复一日，宝贵的生命被那些践踏我们边境的人无情剥夺。

sentences.en: In California, an Air Force veteran was raped, murdered, and beaten to death with a hammer by an illegal alien with a long criminal history.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，一名空军退伍军人遭到了一名有着长期犯罪史的非法移民的强奸、谋杀，并用锤子残忍殴打致死。

sentences.en: He talks about Americans being killed by illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了美国人被非法移民杀害的事情。

sentences.en: In Georgia, an illegal alien was recently charged with murder for killing, beheading, and dismembering his neighbor.
sentences.zh: 在佐治亚州，一名非法移民最近被指控犯有谋杀罪，因为他杀害、斩首并肢解了他的邻居。

sentences.en: He says at one point,
sentences.zh: 他在某个地方说，

sentences.en: How much more American blood must we shed before Congress does its job?
sentences.zh: 在我们流失多少美国人的鲜血之后，国会才肯开始做事？

sentences.en: It really turns into a very, very partisan argument.
sentences.zh: 这真的变成了一个非常非常党派化的争论。

sentences.en: Democrats in Congress have refused to acknowledge the crisis.
sentences.zh: 国会中的民主党人一直拒绝承认这场危机。

sentences.en: And they have refused to provide our brave border agents with the tools they desperately need to protect our families and our nation.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝为我们勇敢的边境特工提供保护我们家庭和国家所迫切需要的工具。

sentences.en: But so if he's not really making any new points, why the presidential address at all?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果他并没有提出什么新观点，为什么还要发表总统演讲呢？

sentences.en: It seems the president has quite effectively been getting these same points out through Twitter, through news conferences, through all the ways he normally does.
sentences.zh: 看起来总统通过推特、新闻发布会以及所有他通常使用的方式，已经非常有效地传达了这些相同的观点。

sentences.en: Interestingly, Michael, we've learned since you spoke to our colleague Michael Grimbaum earlier this evening that it was really White House aides.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，迈克尔，我们得知——自从你今天早些时候跟我们的同事迈克尔·格林鲍姆交谈过后——这其实是白宫幕僚的主意。

sentences.en: It was his advisors who pushed him to do this speech.
sentences.zh: 是他的顾问们敦促他发表这次演讲。

sentences.en: It was not something he was particularly excited about on his own.
sentences.zh: 这并不是他自己特别热衷的事情。

sentences.en: In fact, in an off-the-record session with television news anchors earlier today, he basically told them he thought this strategy was at some level pointless,
sentences.zh: 事实上，在今天早些时候与电视新闻主播举行的一次闭门会议上，他基本上告诉他们，他认为这个策略在某种程度上毫无意义，

sentences.en: which is something that we have reported in the last several hours.
sentences.zh: 这是我们过去几个小时内报道过的内容。

sentences.en: And I think the president realizes that, to some extent, he's running out of time in this whole debate.
sentences.zh: 我想总统也意识到，在某种程度上，在这场整体辩论中他的时间不多了。

sentences.en: The federal government's been closed now for 17 days, and that closing is really starting to bite.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府已经关闭了17天，这种关闭现在真的开始产生痛苦的影响了。

sentences.en: And I think he realizes that unless he can turn this debate relatively soon, he's going to be left to consider more radical moves, one of which, declaring a national emergency,
sentences.zh: 我想他意识到，除非他能相对较快地扭转这场辩论，否则他将不得不考虑采取更激进的举措，其中之一就是宣布国家紧急状态，

sentences.en: is something that he may yet do.
sentences.zh: 这可能是他随时会做的事。

sentences.en: I think perhaps this was, if you will, a second-last-ditch effort to galvanize the American people and to turn what has seemed at times a manufacture crisis into a genuine crisis.
sentences.zh: 我想也许这可以说是，如果你愿意的话，是激发美国人民、并将有时看起来像是一场人为制造的危机变成真正危机的一次最后的绝望努力。

sentences.en: And one way, perhaps, to measure the success of the speech is whether Mr. Trump will succeed in the call he issued at the end of his remarks.
sentences.zh: 衡量这次演讲是否成功的一个方法，也许是看特朗普先生能否在他在讲话结束时发出的呼吁中取得成功。

sentences.en: He told people...
sentences.zh: 他告诉人们……

sentences.en: To every citizen, call Congress and tell them to finally, after all of these decades, secure our border.
sentences.zh: 致每一位公民，致电国会，告诉他们经过这几十年后，终于要把我们的边境守卫好。

sentences.en: They should call their congresspeople and demand action on this issue.
sentences.zh: 他们应该打电话给国会议员，要求在这个问题上采取行动。

sentences.en: But I felt that the notion of a manufacture crisis was still hanging in the air.
sentences.zh: 但我总觉得“人为危机”这种说法仍然挥之不去。

sentences.en: And I thought, in some ways, one of the most pertinent observations that someone made about this speech was Stuart Stevens,
sentences.zh: 我觉得在某种程度上，关于这次演讲最贴切的观察之一来自斯图尔特·史蒂文斯，

sentences.en: a former campaign advisor to Mitt Romney, who said on Twitter, there are numerous examples of presidential addresses made to calm a frightened public.
sentences.zh: 他是米特·罗姆尼的前竞选顾问，他在推特上说，历史上有很多为了平抚惊恐公众而发表的总统演讲。

sentences.en: This will be the first to frighten a calm public.
sentences.zh: 这将是第一次把平静的公众吓坏的演讲。

sentences.en: I think President Trump tonight was speaking to a public that fundamentally doesn't share his belief that this is a crisis, and I'm not sure he changed enough minds.
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普总统今晚的演讲对象是那些根本不认为这是一场危机的公众，而且我也不确定他是否改变了足够多的想法。

sentences.en: And if people end up calling their congressperson and say, I just watched the president speak, you need to vote for this wall,
sentences.zh: 如果人们最终打电话给他们的国会议员说，我刚刚看了总统的演讲，你们需要投票支持这堵墙，

sentences.en: that would be an indication that President Trump has sufficiently frightened the public and turned a manufactured crisis into a genuine one.
sentences.zh: 这将表明特朗普总统已经充分吓唬了公众，把一场人为制造的危机变成了真正的危机。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样的。

sentences.en: But I think here's the issue.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得问题在于：

sentences.en: I think a lot of people who are going to call their congresspeople are going to say, you need to reopen the agriculture department so farmers get their rebates.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多将要打电话给国会议员的人会说，你们需要重新开放农业部，好让农民拿到他们的补贴。

sentences.en: You need to reopen social services so people don't stop getting their food stamps.
sentences.zh: 你们需要重新开放社会服务部门，这样人们就不会领不到食品券。

sentences.en: I think the problem for President Trump is the real crisis may be the growing one from having a government that continues to be shut down
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普总统面临的问题是，真正的危机可能是由于政府持续关门而日益加剧的危机，

sentences.en: and not from the one that exists along the southern border.
sentences.zh: 而不是存在于南部边境的危机。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So which volume of calls will be higher in the next few days?
sentences.zh: 那么在接下来的几天里，哪一类电话的数量会更多呢？

sentences.en: I think that's the big issue, and I think it might be the government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 我认为这才是大问题，而且我觉得这可能就是政府关门引发的问题。

sentences.en: When I took the oath of office, I swore to protect our country, and that is what I will always do.
sentences.zh: 当我宣誓就职时，我发誓要保护我们的国家，这正是我将永远做的事情。

sentences.en: So help me God.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我。

sentences.en: Thank you, and good night.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，晚安。

sentences.en: And then it was the Democrats' turn.
sentences.zh: 接下来轮到民主党人了。

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好。

sentences.en: I appreciate the opportunity to speak directly to the American people tonight about how we can end this shutdown and meet the needs of the American people.
sentences.zh: 我很感激今晚能有机会直接向美国人民发表讲话，谈谈我们如何才能结束这场政府关门并满足美国人民的需求。

sentences.en: Yes, and what you saw was this rather awkward tableau of Nancy Pelosi, the new Speaker of the House, standing next to Chuck Schumer, against a backdrop of American flags.
sentences.zh: 是的，你所看到的是这样一个相当尴尬的画面：新任众议院议长南希·佩洛西站在查克·舒默旁边，背景是一面面美国国旗。

sentences.en: Pelosi spoke firSt.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西首先发言。

sentences.en: Sadly, much of what we heard from President Trump throughout this sense of shutdown has been full of misinformation and even malice.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，在这次关门风波中，我们从特朗普总统那里听到的大部分言论都充满了错误信息甚至恶意的谎言。

sentences.en: The president has chosen fear.
sentences.zh: 总统选择了恐惧。

sentences.en: We want to start with the facts.
sentences.zh: 我们要从事实讲起。

sentences.en: She did a very brief effort to sort of disprove a lot of the arguments that the president was making.
sentences.zh: 她进行了非常简短的尝试，试图驳斥总统提出的大量论点。

sentences.en: On the very first day of this Congress,
sentences.zh: 在这届国会的第一天，

sentences.en: House Democrats passed Senate Republican legislation to reopen government and fund smart, effective border security solutions.
sentences.zh: 众议院民主党人就通过了参议院共和党人的立法，以重新开放政府并资助明智、有效的边境安全解决方案。

sentences.en: But the president is rejecting these bipartisan bills, which would reopen government, over his obsession with forcing American taxpayers
sentences.zh: 但总统却拒绝了这些两党法案——这些法案本可以重新开放政府——原因是他执迷于逼迫美国纳税人

sentences.en: to waste billions of dollars on an expensive and ineffective wall.
sentences.zh: 把数十亿美元浪费在一堵昂贵且毫无成效的墙上。

sentences.en: And she then pivoted to basically getting into the unfairness of the president holding the government hostage to a border wall.
sentences.zh: 然后她话锋一转，主要谈到了总统以边境墙为筹码绑架政府的不公正性。

sentences.en: He promised to keep government shut down for months or years, no matter whom it hurts.
sentences.zh: 他承诺让政府关闭几个月甚至几年，不管伤害到谁。

sentences.en: That's just plain wrong.
sentences.zh: 这简直是大错特错。

sentences.en: So her effort, in essence, was to throw the onus of the argument back on President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因此，她此举的本质是将辩论的矛头重新抛回给特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Leader Schumer.
sentences.zh: 参议院领袖舒默。

sentences.en: Thank you, Speaker Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，佩洛西议长。

sentences.en: My fellow Americans, we address you tonight for one reason only.
sentences.zh: 我亲爱的美国同胞们，我们今晚向你们发表讲话只有一个原因。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer spoke next.
sentences.zh: 接下来是查克·舒默发言。

sentences.en: Make no mistake.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Democrats and the president both want stronger border security.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和总统都希望加强边境安全。

sentences.en: However, we sharply disagree with the president about the most effective way to do it.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们在如何做到这一点最有效的问题上，与总统存在严重分歧。

sentences.en: He basically said,
sentences.zh: 他基本上说过，

sentences.en: Most presidents have used Oval Office addresses for noble purposes.
sentences.zh: 大多数总统使用椭圆形办公室的讲话都是为了崇高的目的。

sentences.en: This president just used the backdrop of the Oval Office to manufacture a crisis, stoke fear, and divert attention from the turmoil in his administration.
sentences.zh: 这位总统刚刚利用椭圆形办公室作为背景来制造危机、煽动恐惧，并转移人们对他政府内部动荡的注意力。

sentences.en: And he ended by challenging the president to reopen the government and then have a legitimate debate with Democrats over border security.
sentences.zh: 他最后呼吁总统重新开放政府，然后与民主党人就边境安全展开合理的辩论。

sentences.en: Just don't hold the government hostage to that debate.
sentences.zh: 只是不要拿政府作为这场辩论的人质。

sentences.en: Mr. President, reopen the government and we can work to resolve our differences over border security, but end this shutdown now.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，请重新开放政府，我们可以努力解决我们在边境安全上的分歧，但现在就结束这场政府关门吧。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I couldn't help thinking, Mark, as I watched this, that the two sides of this border security debate had borrowed the dignity of that hallway in the Capitol and the Oval Office
sentences.zh: 马克，当我看这个节目时，我不禁想到，这场边境安全辩论的双方都借用了国会山走廊和椭圆形办公室的庄严感，

sentences.en: to have the exact same highly partisan debate that they have all day long in front of tens of millions of Americans.
sentences.zh: 来开展与他们整天在数千万美国人面前进行的完全相同的极具党派色彩的辩论。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And preempt regular programming on TV to do it.
sentences.zh: 并且为此打断了电视上的常规节目。

sentences.en: You know, I agree.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我同意。

sentences.en: I couldn't help but feeling at the end of watching both addresses that our government had intruded on the Tuesday night of millions of Americans.
sentences.zh: 看完这两场演讲后，我不禁有一种感觉，那就是我们的政府侵扰了数百万美国人的周二夜晚。

sentences.en: This is a debate that, as Chuck Schumer said, ought to be thrashed out in the halls of Congress, in the Oval Office between President Trump and the congressional leadership.
sentences.zh: 正如查克·舒默所说，这是一场本该在国会大厅里、在椭圆形办公室里由特朗普总统和国会领导层激烈争论的问题。

sentences.en: Sure, it's the stuff of evening news.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是晚间新闻的素材。

sentences.en: We talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论它。

sentences.en: We write about it in newspapers.
sentences.zh: 我们在报纸上写它。

sentences.en: But it doesn't get elevated to the level of a communal national crisis.
